about.title: About this viewer
about.name: A reverie is a daydream, and a virtual world is a daydream we share. Reverie Viewer is a modern, open-source viewer for OpenSimulator grids and Second Life: familiar where it should be, better where it can be.
about.ai: The name also nods to the AI it was built with. "Reverie" was the simulation at the heart of the Generative Agents study, where AI agents lived out their days in a small virtual town. Reverie Viewer was built with AI, and AI agents helped test it.
about.founders: Reverie comes from one of the original Founders of InWorldz, whose motto was "Where your dreams are our vision." This viewer carries that idea forward to the grids that came after.
about.credits: Created by Legion Builds and contributors. Includes code from the Second Life viewer by Linden Research, Inc. and from other open-source projects; see Licenses for each project and its notice.
about.licence: {0} is free software under the GNU Lesser General Public License, version 2.1. Source code: {1}
about.support: Support is best effort: report problems on the GitHub issues page.
about.trademarks: Second Life and Linden Lab are trademarks of Linden Research, Inc.
disclosure.title: Before you use Reverie Viewer
disclosure.title.second_life: Before you log in to Second Life
disclosure.body: Reverie Viewer is a third-party viewer. It is not provided or supported by Linden Lab, the makers of Second Life.
disclosure.text:
Support: Reverie Viewer is an early preview, supported on a best-effort basis by its developers. Report problems at {0}. Linden Lab cannot help with problems in this viewer.

What differs from the official viewer: Reverie Viewer adds an animation overrider, add-ons, and restrictions that worn scripted objects can ask for (RLV, off until you turn it on). Some features of the official viewer are missing or work differently, among them voice chat, media, search, and land tools.

Content: worlds you visit can show content that is not rated General. What you see depends on the maturity rating of the region and on your own account settings.

Privacy: what this viewer sends, and to whom, is in its privacy policy: {1}

addons.title: Add-ons
addons.intro: Add-ons add features to the viewer. The ones that come with the viewer are on unless you turn them off; one you installed stays off until you turn it on and accept what it asks for. Add-ons run inside the viewer as trusted code: install only ones you trust.
addons.permission.none: (nothing beyond its own window and settings)
addons.permission.session: know when you log in or out and which region you are in
addons.permission.motion: know your avatar's motion (standing, walking, flying, sitting) and mouse-look
addons.permission.animations.read: see the animations your avatar plays
addons.permission.animations.play: play and stop animations on your avatar
addons.permission.chat.read: read local chat and your own objects' messages to you
addons.permission.chat.send: say things in local chat as you
addons.permission.filter: allow or refuse your sit, stand and teleport
addons.permission.inventory.read: read the names and folders of your inventory
addons.permission.inventory.write: make folders and links, rename folders and move things to the Trash, inside the one folder it names
addons.permission.region.read: see the world around you: your camera and avatar's place, the region's water, ground and wind, and the sun and sky
addons.permission.sound.play: play its own sounds to you
